fields.summary: The company may face regulatory, insurance and civil inquiries about the incident of October 22. The law requires that relevant documents be kept.
instructions: Do not delete, edit or discard any document, message or file about the incident.
Keep it even if a retention schedule would normally remove it.
Do not forward this notice outside the company.
Tell the legal department about any other person who has relevant material.
fields.scope: Email, chat, tickets, logs, notes and files from September 1, 2026 forward, on company and personal devices used for work.
fields.autoDelete: IT will suspend automatic deletion for email, chat and ticket systems today and confirm in writing.

fields.summary: Outside counsel has engaged the forensic firm. Work done at counsel's direction is more likely to stay privileged if it is kept within the response team.
instructions: Send forensic questions and findings through the legal department or outside counsel only.
Do not write conclusions about cause or fault in email or chat.
Mark requests for legal advice 'Request for legal advice'.
Do not share the forensic report outside the response team.
fields.scope: This reminder covers the response team and anyone who receives forensic material.
